game.title: Kho-Kho
game.description: A ancient tag game dating back to 4th century BC, where chasing team members sit in a row and pass turns by touching seated teammates while chasing runners.
howToPlay: Step 1: A rectangular court has a central lane with two poles at ends.
Step 2: Chasing team has 9 players on field, 8 sitting in central lane alternately facing opposite directions.
Step 3: One active chaser runs and tries to tag defending runners.
Step 4: Active chaser cannot cross central lane or change direction once running toward a pole.
Step 5: To change direction or halves, chaser must run behind a pole or tag a seated teammate saying 'Kho'.
Step 6: Tagged defenders leave the field.
Step 7: Each team gets two turns of 9 minutes each.
Step 8: Runners try to avoid tags using speed and agility.
Step 9: Points scored for each successful tag.
Step 10: Team with highest score wins.
